definitions.short: Tsin , a part of the Desert
definitions.full: H6790. Tsin צִן proper name, of a location Σ ( ε ) ιν ; name of wilderness south of Canaan , where lay Kadesh Barnea, with ה locative צִ֫נָה Num 34:4 (where Lag BN 47 חצן ), Josh 15:3 (van d. H. צִ֫נָּה in Joshua); elsewhere מִדְבַּרצִֿן Num 13:21 ; 20:1 ; 27:14 (twice in verse); 33:36 ; 34:3 ; Deut 32:51 ; Josh 15:1 (all P). [ צֵן ], I, II, III. צִנָּה , see I, II, III. צנן . below
